_comment: Per-category CI severity for the MicroPython 1.27 compatibility ratchet. 'warn' = reported as ::warning:: but CI stays green. 'fail' = blocks CI (::error::) on any occurrence outside allowed_files. MONOTONIC: edits may only flip warn->fail or shrink allowed_files, never the reverse (review-enforced). Each mpy/0N PR flips ITS category to 'fail' in the same diff that drives its count to zero. Start state: every category 'warn' (CI green, full inventory visible).
